senses.gloss:
Kaumāra
pāñcarātra. mentioned in Bhāradvājasaṁhitā, MT. 1343 (c).

Kaumāra
Śaivāgama. Upāgama of Lalitāgama.
See list in Kāmika.

Kaumārakhaṇḍa
or kau. saMhitA of Brahmāṇḍapurāṇa, Ādipuramāhātmya from. IO. 6658. MD. 2370.

Kaumāratantra
See Kumāratantra.

Kaumāratīya_(?)
Oppert I. 7289.

Kaumārapurāṇa
Kavīndrācārya 1419.

Kaumārabali
rites of worshipping Kumāra. a.. TCD. 973C. Trav. Uni. C. 320C.
C.. Kumāratantra, Balidānavidhi from.

Kaumārayoga
Kavīndrācārya 2119.

Kaumāralāta
See Kumāralāta.

Kaumāravyākaraṇa
See Kātantra NCC. III. p.. 306 ff. Addl. mss.: B. III. 6. Gough p. 51. Oppert I. 7181. 7542.

Kaumārasaṃhitā
Gough p. 168. Gov. Or. Libr. Madras 20 (mantra). IM. 470. Mysore 4 (8 adhyāyas).
--tantra. Stein 228. [Page108-b]

Kaumārasārasamuccaya
gr. in 3100 verses. Jainagranthāvalī p. 304.
See NCC. III. p. 308b under Kātantra.

Kaumārāḥ
followers of the Kātantra grammar. Q. in Mādhavīyadhātuvṛtti; by Jagadīśa in Śabdaśaktiprakāsikā, JASB (NS) XI (1915) 281; by Bhaṭṭoji, Oxf. 162b an. mentioned by Madhusūdana in Prasthānabheda.

Kaumārāgama
Kavīndrācārya 1584.

Kaumārikākhaṇḍa
Pt.. Skandapurāṇa I. Bombay 1909-11. See Kumārikākhaṇḍa, NCC. III. p. 223a.

Kaumārilatilaka
or kaumArilayuktimAlA mīm. poem. based on Kumārila's works an. using the Cāndra Vākyas of Vararuci. by Vāsudeva II of Payyūr Bhāṭṭa family in Kerala, son of Ṛṣi II an. Gopālikā. MT. 3060 (e). 3607 (e).
See JOR. Madras XV. p.. 13 ff.; Poona Ori. XXII. p. 54; IHQ. V. p. 679; J. of Trav. Uni. Ori. Mss. Libr. VI. p.. 14-15; Contribution of Kerala to Skt. Lit. p. 96.

Kaumārilamatopanyāsa
a. outline of Kumārila's system in 150(1/2) verses. by Nārāyaṇa, pupil of Subrahmaṇya. Trav. Uni. 1207D.
Ed. TSS. 171.
See also Intro. to Jaiminīya Sūtrārthasaṁgraha, TSS. 156, on the a.

Kaumārī
tantra. ref. to by Gaurīkānta. Oxf. 108b.
See also Kumārasaṁhitā, NCC. IV. p. 211.

Kaumārīkauśala
one of the sources used by Narapati, ref. to by him a. the beg. of his [Page109-a. Narapatijayacaryā (Svarodaya). Cambr. 69. IO. 3109 (verse 6).

Kaumārīpūjā
Nepal I. p. 46.

Kaumārīmantra
from Ākāśabhairavakalpa (ch. 68). MD. 7802. Trav. Uni. 8599 (u).
See NCC. II. p. 3b, under Ākāśaº.

Kaumārīyonikuṇḍapūjāvidhi
tantra. Trav. Uni. 2858Z-3.

Kaumārīśānti
from Matsyapurāṇa. Burnell 149a. TD. 13278.

Kaumārīśāntyanvādhānakrama
gṛh. TD. 13279.

Kaumāryādyutsavapratiṣṭhāvidhi
MT. 6615 (inc.).

Kaumudī
See separate entries like Ācāra K., Kṛtya K., Kriyā K., Jyotiṣa K., Prakriyā K., Vrata K., Saṅgīta K., Siddhānta K., Śuddhi K. an. Smṛti K.

Kaumudī
dh. Q. by Raghunandana (C. 1515-45) in his Āhnika Tattva (Serampore edn. I. 226).
See JASB (NS) XI (1915) 365.

Kaumudī
latter part in the names of 18 dh. texts by Pītāmbara Siddhānta Vāgīśa of Kochbehar.
See Ācārakaumudī, NCC. II. p. 22a; also Rep. Hpr. 1901-6, p. 13.

Kaumudī
gr. by Raṅgārya (?). Mad. Uni. 40.

Kaumudī
tantra. by Śrī Kṛṣṇa. Mithilā.

Kaumudī
by Rāmacandra. BP. p. 254a.
C.. below C. on Amarakośa completed by Rāmacandra an. Prakriyākaumudī of Rāmacandra.

Kaumudī
unspecified. Most of them are likely to be Siddhāntakaumudī; a few may be Prakriyākaumudī. [Page109-b]
Akalamannattu Mana 44. 50. 57 (inc.). Ani. Āvaṇapparambu Mana 141. Cranganore 94. 103 (Uttarārdha). 120. 123. 127. 161. 172. 218 (last two Uttarārdha). 226. 243. 247. IM. 7834 (inc. 2 chs.). Killimaṅgalattu Mana 25. Kiṭaṅgaśśerī Mana 38. Kizhakkumbhāgattu Mana 56A. Mad. Uni. 116. Putuvāmana Mana 45. Ramesvaram 14. 246. 253. 341. 353. Rohtek 119 (with C.). Śeṣayya 1884 (p. 82) (Uttarārdha). Sri. Dev. 482 (Taddhita). Tekke maṭham I. 83. Vidyaranyapura 9. 15. 29.
--C. Paliyam 35. 69. 75. 132 (c) (inc.). 153 (inc.). 343 (inc.). 375 (inc.). Rohtek 119.

Kaumudī
probably Siddhānta Kau., gr., on which the C. Pūrṇimā was written by Raṅganātha Dīkṣita (a. of Padamañjarī-makaranda).
See MT. 634 (g) of a. (vyAkhyA hi padamaJjaryAH kaumudyAH pUrNimA tathA).

Kaumudī
Q. in C.s on Amarakośa by Nārāyaṇa (See JOR. Madras XII. p. 7); by Rāyamukuṭa (Adyar D. VI. 966); by Bhānuji (Oxf. 182b) an. by Bharatasena on Bhaṭṭi II. 15.
See also ZDMG. 28 (1874), p. 112. IHQ. XVII. p.. 468-70; JOR. Madras VI. p. 261; NCC. I. Revised edn. p.. 325-6.

Kaumudī
name of C. by Kaumudīśvara of Bengal on Amarakośa. Q. by Rāyamukuṭa.
See NCC. I. Revised edn. p. 325b.

Kaumudī
name of C. by Tarkapañcānana Bhaṭṭācārya on Amarakośa. C.. VII. D. 31.

Kaumudī
name of C. commenced by Nayanānanda Śarman an. completed by his [Page110-a. pupil Rāmacandra Śarman on Amarakośa.
See NCC. I. Revised edn. p. 326b.

Kaumudī
name of C. on Kāvyaprakāśa. Q. by Narasiṁha Ṭhakkura.
See NCC. IV. p. 93a.

Kaumudī
name of C. on Devīmāhātmya. Adyar.

Kaumudī
name of C.. by Udaya (or Uttuṅgodaya) on Abhinavagupta's C. Locana on Dhvanyāloka.
See NCC. II. p.. 315b. 325a.
Pt.. in edn. KSRI., Madras, 1944.

Kaumudī
name of C. by Govindānanda on Śrāddhaviveka of Śūlapāṇi. L. 3175.

Kaumudī
name of C. by Govindarāma Siddhānta Vāgīśa on Mahimnasstotra. SK. Ray 474.

Kaumudī
name of C. by Peddasūri on Puṣpadanta's Mahimnasstava. Mysore I. p. 224. Paliyam p. 85 (Pº Bhaṭṭa). Trav. Uni. 2980C (with text, inc.).
C.. next.

Kaumudī
name of C. by Buddhisūri, son of Cenna Bhaṭṭa on Puṣpadanta's Mahimnasstuti. MT. 1645 (a..

Kaumudī
name of C. by Vācaspati on Mahimnasstava. Hpr. III. 225.

Kaumudī
name of C. by Rāmeśvara Śivayogibhikṣu on Mīmāṁsārthasaṅgraha of Laugākṣi Bhāskara.
Pt.. Benares, 1915. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1892-1906. 88. 553; 1906-28. 153.

Kaumudī
name of C. by Abhirāma Vidyālaṅkāra on Goyicandra's Saṁkṣiptasāraṭīkā. IO. 831. 832.

Kaumudī
name of unspecified C.s: [Page110-b]
--C. Gūḍhabhāvadīpikā. Lucknow Mus.
--C. Tattvaratnāvalī. gr. Sri. Dev. 634 (Samāsa an. Tiṅanta).
--C. Vilāsa. R. A. Sastri II. p. 178.

Kaumudī_(?)
Jain. Lakṣmīsena p. 27 (in Skt. prose).

Kaumudīkathā
Jain. BORI. 20 of 1869-70. BP. p. 237a. D. p. 7. Delhi MJP. p. 8 (no. 150) (with C.). Jhalrapatan p. 28 (2 mss. in prose). (4 mss. in verse). Mandlik Sup. 422.
--C. Delhi MJP. p. 8 (no. 150).
See Samyaktvakaumudī kathā.

Kaumudīkalpalatikā
gr. by Pt. Rāja Śrī Veṇīmādhava Śukla.
Pt.. Haridas Skt. Series 28.

Kaumudīkāvya
Jain. Lakṣmīsena p. 11.

Kaumudīkumuda
a play (?) Sangam 101.

Kaumudītantra
ref. to by Yogendra, in his Āgamasārasaṅgraha, RASB. VIII. A. 6220.

Kaumudīnāṭaka
nāṭaka. by Rāmacandra. Chani 3487. Jainagranthāvalī p. 336.
See Kaumudīmitrānanda.

Kaumudī_Nāma_Pañjikā
Bud. by Durjayacandra. Cordier II. p. 67.

Kaumudīnirṇaya
dh. B. III. 80.

Kaumudīpūrvapakṣa
Ahmedabad 7845 (fr.).

Kaumudīprakāśa
gr. by Tolappa (wrongly Appā) Dīkṣita. Oppert I. 7916. II. 2470. TD. 5661.

Kaumudīprakriyā
BP. p. 244b.

Kaumudīprabhā
name of C. by Svapneśvara on Sāṃkhyatattvakaumudī. Hall p. 6.

Kaumudīprasāda
See Prakriyākaumudīprasāda.

Kaumudīmahotsava
nāṭaka in 5 Acts; the ascription to Vijjikā is baseless. MT. 2766.
Pt.. (1) Dakshiṇa Bhāratī Ser. 4, Madras, 1929. (2) with Eng. transl. by Sakuntala Rao Sastri, Bombay, 1952. [Page111-a.
On the supposed historical data in it see ABORI. XII. 1930-1, p.. 50-56; IHQ. XIV. p.. 582-602; XXXII. p.. 417-24; J. of Ind. an. Bud. Studies, Tokyo, IV. (1956), p.. 590 ff.

Kaumudīmahotsāha
collection of grammatical texts (of Pāṇini, Bhaṭṭoji an. Rāmacandra Bhikājī Guñjīkara) with Marathi versions a. places.
Pt.. Bombay, 1877-79. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1876-92. 328.

Kaumudīmitrānanda
or kaumudInATaka play of the Prakaraṇa type. by Rāmacandra, pupil of Hemacandra. Chani 1461. 3487. Jainagranthāvalī p. 336.
Q. by a. in his Nāṭyadarpaṇa, GOS. XLVIII. p. 70.
Ed. Muni Punyavijaya, Ātmānanda Jainagranthamālā 59. Bhavnagar, 1917.
For a detailed note see E. Hultzsch, ZDMG. 75 (1921), p.. 63-66. Also Intro. p. 87, Viśvatattvaprakāśa, Jīvāraja Jainagranthamālā, 16. Sholapur, 1964.

Kaumudīvallabhabhūpa
--C. Śṛṅgāradīpikā on Śṛṅgāraśataka of Bhartṛhari. PUL. II. p. 261.

Kaumudīvidyāvilāsa
or vidyAvilAsa gr. by Śivarāma. AS. p. 51.

Kaumudīvilāsa
name of C. by Bhāskara on Siddhāntakaumudī. PUL. II. p. 99. TD. 5656.

Kaumudīvyākhyāvilāsa
by Lakṣmaṇasiṁha. Paliyam 78. C. on Siddhāntakaumudī ?

Kaumudīśvara
Q. in the a.. C. on Amarakośa, MT. 3356 (p. 283).
See JOR. Madras VI. p.. 249, 261.
--Kaumudī, C. on Amarakośa.
See above under Kaumudī. [Page111-b]

Kaumudīṣaṭpadī_Kathā
Jain. Lakṣmīsena p. 3.

Kaumudīsāra
gr. Radh. 8.
See Sārasiddhāntakaumudī.

Kaumudīsārasaṅgraha
gr. a summary of Siddhāntakaumudī of Bhaṭṭoji Dīkṣita. by Vedāntācārya. Adyar II. p. 75b (1-4 chs.). Adyar D. VI. 375 (inc.).

Kaumudīsudhākara
prakaraṇa. by Candrakānta Tarkālaṅkāra.
Pt.. Calcutta, 1888. See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 1303.

Kaumudīsoma
nāṭaka in 5 Acts. by Kṛṣṇa Śāstrin of Paruttiyūr in Tanjore, patronised by King Rāmavarman Āyilyam Tirunāl of Travancore in 1866 A. D.
Pt.. Madras, 1896. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1892-1906. 324.
